Subject: Echoworks pilot onboarding — PO requirement?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get a short pilot started with Redwood. We're preparing the paperwork from our side and wanted to confirm Redwood's PO policy for small pilots. The pilot scope is a single-month evaluation (upto ~USD 3,500) and we'll be using the standard SOW we sent.

Two quick asks:
- Can Echoworks be onboarded without a formal purchase order for this pilot, and instead send an invoice after completion?
- If not, is there an expedited path or temporary exception for pilots under $5k?

If helpful, I can attach our W-9 and the signed SOW. We prefer to keep velocity high. Let me know what evidence you need and who on your side should be copied.

Best,

Subject: Re: Echoworks pilot onboarding — PO requirement?

Hi Samira — great to meet you yesterday.

Short answer: our standard policy is to require a purchase order for customer invoices that run through our AP system, but we do make time-limited exceptions for low-dollar pilots to avoid blocking momentum. To evaluate an exception I need three things from you:

1) Completed vendor onboarding form (basic company info, billing contact, tax id)
2) W-9 (we received that — thanks)
3) Signed pilot SOW or invoiceable statement of work

If those are in place, Finance can approve a temporary "invoice-only" path for single-invoice pilots up to USD 5,000 with the following guardrails: single invoice cap $5k, Net 30 payment, billing email to ap-billing@redwood.com, and a named approver on our side. We'll also treat this as a one-time exception unless we transition you to a master services agreement and standard PO intake.

I've looped in Marissa (AE) and Laura (Finance) to confirm operational steps. Marissa — if sales signs off on scope and there's a clear renewal/expansion path, can we fast-track procurement? Laura — are those guardrails above ok from a finance/risk perspective?

Samira, I attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf below to speed things up — please complete and return with any supporting docs and I'll track the approval.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Procurement | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Quick note from the AE side — I'm fully supportive of a temporary no-PO path for this one-month pilot. Echoworks is low-risk and the deal motion will be much smoother without a PO stall.

Operational asks to make Finance comfortable:
- Echoworks to send a single invoice capped at $3,500 and clearly marked as "Pilot - Invoice #"
- Billing contact and remit-to email included on the onboarding form
- Customer success or AE confirmation of delivery milestones (simple check-in email after pilot completion)

If Finance gives the thumbs up, I'll confirm scope in writing so Laura has a reference to approve against.

-Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Echoworks pilot onboarding — PO requirement?

Hi all — Finance here. We can approve a one-off invoice-only onboarding for Echoworks under the following conditions:

1) Max single invoice amount: USD 5,000 (pilot is within that range)
2) Net 30 payment terms; payment run after invoice receipt and verification of delivery by AE/CS
3) Echoworks must provide W-9 (received), completed Vendor Onboarding Form (please attach), and a remit-to billing contact
4) Internal approver: Laura Bennett (Finance) will review and sign the temporary exception; exception expires if further invoices are expected without a PO
5) For risk reasons we also require a company registration number or DUNS if available (optional but preferred)

Please upload the completed onboarding form and any supporting docs to the secure Drive link I've created: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cEchoworksOnboard (shared with Echoworks). Once I confirm the documents are complete I'll execute the exception approval and send a one-line confirmation email to ap-billing@redwood.com.

Also Samira, please direct your invoice to: ap-billing@redwood.com and reference Redwood PO: EXCEPTION-2025-032. I'll track the exception internally.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
